name: Report to Helgrum
label: Quest
description: Neeka Bloodscar has written a fresh report for Helgrum the Swift in Stonard, and asks you to carry it there. This follows your visit to Neeka at Kargath.
intro: Neeka Bloodscar has written a fresh report for Helgrum the Swift in Stonard, and asks you to carry it there. This follows your visit to Neeka at Kargath.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I wrote a fresh report for Helgrum in Stonard. Bring it to him.
And if you consider yourself an outrunner, then don't lose your way. Or fall to an enemy.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You returned. You have a report?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you, friend. From Neeka's report, I see the Alliance is not without its own problems. And we may find that some enemies are shared between us.
